assumptions: Conditional optically maintained CdS-alizarin recombination hypothesis, distinct from N767 chemical-fuel chemomotor. current_objective: Measure specimen-specific formation and recombination field derivatives after charge formation, dipole-orientation lifetime, kinetics in the actual host and complete illuminated dielectric/carrier/contact losses. Require a confidence upper bound ReY_complete<0 under constant pump and zeroDC; retain device losses and all controls. Then independently verify RF power flow/passive stored-energy growth and full optical/electrical/thermal accounting before prototype or scaling claims.
